answer: Reference architecture for Modular Business Management Platform: Build a maintainable business application spanning domain rules, persistence, reporting, testing, security, and deployment. Implement milestones in order, keep the core rule logic independently testable, add explicit validation and failure handling, then verify the documented deployment path.
explanation: This is a protected reference outline rather than a claim that a complete application has been implemented. Reviewers should add and run a complete solution before publication.
checks: Model customers, products, inventory, and orders
Separate presentation, application, domain, and persistence concerns
Use LINQ for search/reporting and async I/O where appropriate
Protect updates with validation and transaction boundaries
Test important rules and integration boundaries
Add structured logs, secure configuration, and deployment instructions
